title: 0x0 Thestore AIgent
tagline: Agent tool for store owners, setting up a profile, registering products, registering sales, and a swiss knife of tools for DeFi
description: The project is an Eth Agent for Latin American store owners, utilizing blockchain technology, DeFi protocols, and secure data management to streamline business operations. The agent features an interactive AI interface powered by GPT-4, blockchain interaction through Coinbase Developer Platform, wallet management, and cryptocurrency operations, as well as secure data storage and inventory tracking systems. The system is designed to provide a comprehensive solution for merchants, with features such as encrypted store profiles, secure vaults, and real-time sales analytics, and is expected to integrate with Telegram in the future.
how_its_made: The project is built using the AgentKit framework, which provides a robust foundation for building conversational AI agents. The project also leverages Nillion for encrypted database storage and querying, and utilizes the Base blockchain as its underlying platform. Additionally, Telegram integration is achieved through the Telegram API, allowing merchants to interact with the agent through a familiar messaging interface. The combination of these technologies enables the creation of a secure and decentralized system for managing business information, with Nillion's encryption providing a secure way to store and retrieve sensitive data.
